items.title: Single-image Comment opens the general composer
items.precondition: Contained runtime; signed in; an image-only post with exactly one persisted image and no existing general comments.
steps: Open the post detail and record the Comment count shown below its image.
Confirm the URL is /posts/:postId#comments and the general Comments section is visible.
Type a short comment, then attach a photo and retain text before submitting.
items.expected: The action scrolls to and focuses the general post composer. Text plus photo is accepted, appears in the general thread after submission/reload, and the displayed action count reflects the general thread.
items.evidence: 2026-08-21: user confirmed the single-image Comment action opens the general composer and accepts the tested comment flow.

items.title: Single-image empty state exposes a composer
items.precondition: Contained runtime; signed in; an image-only single-image post with an empty caption and no general comments.
steps: Inspect the end of the post detail without submitting a comment.
Submit a text-only comment, then return to the same hash route.
items.expected: The general Comments section and composer are mounted in both the empty and populated states; no extra interaction is required to reveal the input.
items.evidence: 2026-08-21: user confirmed the image-only single-photo comment composer is available without manually revealing it.

items.title: Multi-image photo comments remain scoped
items.precondition: Contained runtime; signed in; a post with two persisted images.
steps: Open the post detail and click Comment under the first image.
Confirm the URL includes that image’s /photos/:photoId path and submit a comment.
Open the second image’s Comment action.
items.expected: Each image keeps its own photo-comments route and count. A comment on the first image is not displayed in the second image’s thread or in a general single-photo-style composer.
items.evidence: 2026-08-21: user confirmed multi-photo behavior remained usable after the change.

items.title: Frontend quality gates
items.expected: All commands exit 0, or any pre-existing/environment failures are documented and no failure is caused by this execution.
items.evidence: 2026-08-21: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck and npm --prefix frontend run build exited 0 after T4, the hash-scroll quickfix, and T5. npm --prefix frontend run lint exited 0 with six existing warnings (including the pre-existing PostDetailPage hook-dependency warning); no new lint warning was introduced. npm run check:conventions is unavailable because the root package has no such script.
items.notes: Automated quality gates plus user-confirmed local-app acceptance.

items.title: General Comment navigation reveals the input
items.precondition: Contained runtime; signed in; a single-image post with several general comments so the composer is below the initial viewport.
steps: Open the post detail near the image action row and click Comment.
Confirm the top-level composer is visible and ready to type without manually scrolling.
items.expected: Smooth navigation places the top-level general comment input within the viewport, centered where space allows. It does not scroll to an inline reply input or alter a multi-image photo comment route.
items.evidence: 2026-08-21: user confirmed Comment navigation now automatically reaches the top-level composer.

items.title: Multi-photo carousel begins with photos
items.precondition: Contained runtime; signed in; a post with at least two persisted photos.
steps: Open the post detail and scroll to the multi-photo carousel.
Verify the carousel begins with photo content, then browse the photos.
Use an image preview, reaction, Comment action, and Share control.
items.expected: The “Photo album” title, “N photos · scroll to browse” helper text, and standalone album count are absent. The per-photo position marker and all existing photo interactions remain usable.
items.evidence: 2026-08-21: user confirmed the multi-photo carousel header text was removed and the carousel remained usable.
